versions.author: designer
versions.summary:
Lemmings that make identical little Kit tokens, with extras waiting in an off-board Burrow.
The Burrow is spent three ways: as fight HP through Onward, as missiles, or as permanent stats for your real units.

versions.author: reviser
versions.summary:
Defined the front unit and the turn order as tribe rules, and made Identical Cousin say who chooses and what the copy keeps.
Herding Council now grows Kit size, Tally counts the Herd for gold, and Tunic Weaver picks Attack or Health, so the midgame has more to grow and decide.
